Georgian Civil Wedding 💒💍
Hi dear group!

Did someone recently get married in Georgia and can answer me some questions?🙏🏽

1. Did you use an agent? Can you recommend one?

2. Or you did the process by yourself?

3. Misrad Hapnim accepted the marriage certificate in English or was necessary to translate it to Hebrew?

TIA ❤️‍🩹
